(named under the value). 1.0x is even, above is faster.
Default import, precision 5. Run of 2026-11-26 on an AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, Windows. 49 cells faster, 3
Within the noise: polytini was ahead in some rounds and
behind in others, so call it even

svg.text: "real" is the 1000 real-world lines, median 82 points. Each cell is the median of 5 interleaved rounds; between
rounds a cell moved by a median of 29% to 35%, depending on the runtime.
googlemaps is @googlemaps/polyline-codec, mapbox is @mapbox/polyline, placemarkio is @placemarkio/polyline,
pirxpilot is @pirxpilot/google-polyline. Every number is in docs/results.md.
